plan: Drive: from District of Squamish, about 65 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.23209, -123.07939, pull off on Soo River FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 7.5 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 517 m, about 202 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 60 m SE of the spot at 827 m (50.25755, -123.17632). Water: Soo River 40 m W (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 2-11, Region 2. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R2B-duck-backcountry-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 2-11: about 3,307 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.98 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
